sections.text:
-Ability Power 360. Damages all enemies with magic light damage.
-Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Reduces physical and magic damage taken by all allies by 40% for 40 seconds.
-Increases the MATK and MDEF of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Heals your character by 25% of your max HP every 5 seconds for 30 seconds.
